description: Get pre-computed AI analysis for a specific campaign: performance summary, detected anomalies (e.g. unusually high bounce rate), and improvement recommendations. Call this after nevent_get_campaign when the user asks "how did this campaign perform?" or "what could be improved?". Complements raw metrics from nevent_get_campaign with narrative insights.

campaign_id.description: The campaign Identifier. Use nevent_list_campaigns to discover valid campaign IDs.

name: nevent_get_campaign_insights
